Class TechnologyTree

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.model.TechnologyTree
public class TechnologyTree extends Object
Technology tree managing civilization progression. Tech levels unlock: - New energy sources - Better resource extraction - Higher carrying capacity - New abilities (irrigation, mining, etc.)
